title: A field transition rebinds the current unmounted follower

verification.actor: One prepared FOLLOWER Cyndaquil with a verified live handle and attached presentation
verification.trigger: Use normal player input to complete one follower Walk, cross from Route29 into Cherrygrove, and take one recovery step
verification.observable: The owner advances epoch and map generation once, retains the same Follower lifetime, restores signed native X/Y ranges to -1, and completes a fresh native Follower Walk and player recovery

setupMutations.change: Prepare Route29/map33 at player585406 facing North before restoring the saved slot-1 Cyndaquil and selecting it through the shared follower setup. This gives no motion, transition, range-restoration, or recovery credit.

limits: Covers one unmounted follower and one Route29-to-Cherrygrove boundary.
Does not prove mounted mid-motion rebind, indoor transitions, or long-run streaming.

events.value: Prepare the exact Route29 start, then bind the saved slot-1 Cyndaquil follower
Walk the short normal route and observe one complete follower Walk
Cross the Cherrygrove field boundary and complete one recovery step
Observe current rebound identity, native signed -1/-1 ranges, and one fresh complete Follower Walk

stop.condition: One map change, current same-lifetime Follower with native signed -1/-1 and a fresh completed Walk, plus player settled one tile inside Cherrygrove

invariants: The bound follower completes one natural Walk before the transition
The field epoch and map generation each advance exactly once
The rebound follower retains its actor lifetime and subject identity
The rebound engine object belongs to the current map and manager
Normal player control completes one recovery step
Native X/Y ranges remain signed -1 before and after field rebind
The current rebound full handle completes a new legal Walk, logical commit and native control return
